description:
Get the full enriched catalog record for one model by its catalog id (spidergate_id or raw provider/model): spec + authored copy + benchmarks + per-provider pricing + links + evals aggregate, with provenance. Read-only, not metered.
The record carries `call_as`: the exact `model` string to pass to gate_chat for it right now, or null when the shared pool cannot serve it now (null does not cover your brand's own unshared keys). Send `call_as`, not the id you looked the record up by — a Codex record's id is refused and its `call_as` is codex/<model_id>.
name: gate_catalog_get
